name: Bourse Direct SA
summary: Bourse Direct SA engages in online stock trading, savings, and financial information business in France. It offers a platform of services, tools, and financial products, including French and foreign equities, derivatives, trackers, warrants, certificates, turbos, mutual funds, UCITS, and CFDs, as well as tax exemption, retirement, real estate, and life insurance products. It also provides back-office and advisory service for institutional clients. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Paris, France. Bourse Direct SA is a subsidiary of E-VIEL SA.
